pins.name: SD_DET_N
pins.label: SD_DET_N (GPIO2)
pins.notes: SD_DET_N - CONFIRMED onboard microSD card-detect, active low (schematic net ~{SD_DET} from J14 microSD pin 9 ~{DET}; matches pins_arduino.h "SD Card detect - Active Low"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: RGB_LED
pins.label: GPIO3 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: RGB_LED / PIN_NEOPIXEL (NUM_NEOPIXEL=1) - CONFIRMED onboard WS2812 addressable RGB LED data line (docs.sparkfun.com: "RGB/IO3 - WS2812 RGB LED tied to the RP2350's IO3"; schematic D4 WS2812B RGB_DIN). digital_input dropped - committed to driving the LED.

pins.name: BATT_ALRT_N
pins.label: BATT_ALRT_N (GPIO6)
pins.notes: BATT_ALRT_N - CONFIRMED onboard MAX17048 fuel-gauge low-battery alert, active low (schematic net ~{BALRT} from U8 MAX17048 ALRT pin; matches pins_arduino.h "Low battery alert - Active Low"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: PERIPHERAL_POWER_ENABLE
pins.label: PERIPHERAL_POWER_ENABLE (GPIO7)
pins.notes: PERIPHERAL_POWER_ENABLE - CONFIRMED peripheral-rail (3.3V_P: microSD/RGB LED/Qwiic) power-enable control, gates U10 RT9080-3.3 EN via net PERI_POW (schematic "JP5 LP - Cut LP jumper to default peripherals to off"; matches pins_arduino.h "Power enable for peripherals - qwiic, sd, rgb. Default HIGH via HW jumper"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: WRL_ON
pins.label: WRL_ON (GPIO24)
pins.notes: WRL_ON - CONFIRMED onboard RM2 radio-module power-enable (schematic net WRL_ON to U2 RM2's WLON pin; matches pins_arduino.h "WiFi power GPIO"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: GPIO25 (Led active low)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_BUILTIN / D25 "aka STAT LED" - CONFIRMED onboard status LED, ACTIVE LOW (raw KiCad trace: ~{STAT} hierarchical label wires to LED D6's cathode, anode pulled to 3.3V_P via R31 2.2k - GPIO LOW lights the LED). docs.sparkfun.com confirms "STAT/25 - Blue LED tied to the RP2350's IO25" but does not state polarity; polarity independently confirmed from the raw schematic source. digital_input dropped - committed to driving the LED.

pins.name: POWER_SRC_5V
pins.label: POWER_SRC_5V (GPIO26)
pins.notes: POWER_SRC_5V - CONFIRMED external-5V-present status flag from U6 LM66200 power-mux ST pin (schematic net 5V_SRC; matches pins_arduino.h "Power status inputs"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: BATT_POWER
pins.label: BATT_POWER (GPIO27)
pins.notes: BATT_POWER - CONFIRMED battery-currently-supplying status flag from U7 LM66200 power-mux ST pin (schematic net BATT_PWR; matches pins_arduino.h "Power status inputs"). No D-alias given by vendor - not general purpose.

pins.name: USER_SW
pins.label: GPIO39 (Button)
pins.notes: USER_SW - CONFIRMED onboard USER pushbutton (raw KiCad trace: SW3 "USER" pulled up 3.3V via R35 10k, other side net ~{USER_BTN} lands on GPIO39 on the RP2350B core sheet). NOTE: docs.sparkfun.com hardware-overview page incorrectly states "USER/36 button connects to IO36" - contradicted by both this board's own pins_arduino.h (USER_SW=(39u), no GPIO36 reference at all) and the schematic (GPIO36 is actually WRL_CLK, part of the RM2 radio module's internal control bus, not a button). Firmware+schematic agreement used as authoritative over the doc-site prose.

pins.name: VIN_MEAS
pins.label: VIN_MEAS (GPIO46)
pins.notes: VIN_MEAS - CONFIRMED dedicated external input-voltage-measurement ADC input (schematic: R28/R29 divider from VRAW; matches pins_arduino.h "Input voltage measurement" + documented "VIN_MEAS = 2.93V @ VIN = 15V" scaling). No A6/D-alias given by vendor despite being ADC-capable (ADC6) - not general purpose.

pins.name: GPIO47
pins.label: GPIO47
pins.notes:
RP2350_PSRAM_CS - CONFIRMED onboard 8MB PSRAM (APS6404L) chip-select (schematic net PSRAM_~{CS} to U4; matches pins_arduino.h RP2350_PSRAM_CS/RP2350_PSRAM_MAX_SCK_HZ define pair). Not broken out, never user-toggled - same PSRAM scaffolding as sparkfun_thingplusrp2350 GPIO8.
